wholePhysicalScope: The OSM footprint fixes the long south alignment, central structure and the mapped end returns. The hotel and NPS report different overall porch lengths; the polygon fixes the modeled exterior plan and no published nominal length is imposed on it.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the full-length porch, continuous roof and square cupola.
limitations: The connected hotel and its current exterior are in scope. Furnishings, grounds, independent service buildings and signage are excluded.

Porch extent follows the mapped building and its end returns. Published survey and promotional lengths use differing measurements. Dimensions of smaller windows, rear connections and roof fittings are estimates.
